note: GGK-200 N-43-II (Geologicheskaya karta SSSR, 1st edition, approved 1963, printed 1967; Irtysh valley / Ishim-Irtysh interfluve, 73-74E 55d20m-56dN), Quaternary map; RASTER = geokniga 2000x2394 px PREVIEW (~34 m/px); the vertical lithology ruling removed before classification (work/r200d/prep_vlines.py, horizontal median 9 px); tints calibrated on the map (preview_tint_calib.py); deluvial dQIII-IV (tint 4.5 dE from the eolian ridges eolQIII) only along the Irtysh right-bank escarpment (--restrict); white lakes and the pale-blue Irtysh/lakes = two WATER rows; el-dQIII cover loams coded E (PI decision 2026-10-04); PREQ dropped (not on the face; its grey took label/line specks); alQIII-II, alQII-III, al+lQII-IIIkrs, saQII and lN2-Q1kc appear only on sections; frame = 4 corners (frame line, checked at 14x) + interior 15x10 min graticule crossings as ties
